answer: Data-shard custody requires 1,000 units to store a unique seed, forming a sparrow of integrity where every agent keeps its file. A verifier sends a random echo to challenge the agent to prove its shard presence, ensuring non-overlapping occupancy. An honest agent pays 1,000 units, while a sybil farm seeking 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000,000 units. Failure to provide a plume of proof voids the identity.
